decision_criteria.FAIL: Official endpoints do not yield plausible player-level facts spanning the early and current eras, leaving no defensible official bulk acquisition path.
decision_criteria.PARTIAL PASS: Some representative game-level eras or season types have gaps, but official game or season endpoints still span the early and current eras and Advanced/Totals works for at least the tested modern seasons.
decision_criteria.PASS: PlayerGameLogs returns plausible bulk rows for every representative regular and playoff season from 1946-47 through 2025-26, while Advanced/Totals works from 1996-97 onward. Player-season facts can therefore be acquired directly where exposed or deterministically aggregated from official game facts.
